content.text: You're a digital creator in a country where Stripe, PayPal, and other conventional [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-honest-side-side-4|COREMERCH guide to coremerch]].github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-what-nobody-tells-7|The COREMERCH]].github.io/store/blog/how-usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-works-how|payment]] platforms have been restricted. You've tried workarounds, but they're often unreliable and unsustainable. Your infrastructure is fragile, and your business is at risk. You need a solution that's built for the people Stripe has locked out – a sovereign digital commerce stack that gives you full control over your online store, payment processing, and data ownership.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

At COREMERCH, we've developed a robust infrastructure that bypasses these restrictions entirely. Our Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) are designed to deploy on Cloudflare Pages, a free and reliable hosting platform, in just 4-6 hours (Stack 01) or 48 hours (Stack 02), respectively. With our solution, you can set up a fully functional digital store that accepts crypto payments through NOWPayments, without relying on Stripe or any other restricted platform.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need to set up a Cloudflare account, create a GitHub or Cloudflare Pages project, and purchase our Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack. You'll also need to have a basic understanding of Google Apps Script, Cloudflare Workers, or Supabase, depending on the stack you choose. Don't worry if you're new to these tools – our documentation and support team are here to help you get started.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

With our infrastructure, you can set up a payment pipeline that accepts over 300 cryptocurrencies through NOWPayments, with a low fee of just 0.5%. You can also configure your delivery pipeline to use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for seamless file delivery to your customers. Our documentation and support team will guide you through the process, ensuring a smooth and hassle-free setup.

Your sovereign digital commerce stack is the key to unlocking true infrastructure sovereignty, where you own and control your online store, payment processing, and data ownership – no more reliance on Stripe or other restricted platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Testing before promotion is not optional — it is the step that determines whether your store functions correctly under real conditions before real buyers encounter it. The test sequence has four steps. First: deploy the backend and confirm the webhook endpoint returns a valid response to a test HTTP POST. Second: configure the storefront and confirm the checkout displays correctly on desktop and mobile. Third: complete a real mainnet transaction with a small amount of actual crypto. Fourth: check your order database and confirm the order was logged correctly, the delivery email arrived, and the download link works.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your business grows, our sovereign digital commerce stack can scale with you. With our Complete Builder Kit ($197), you'll get instant access to all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, ensuring that you have everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your digital commerce stack. Our support team is here to help you every step of the way, so you can focus on what matters most – growing your business and serving your customers.

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: Create a Cloudflare account and set up a GitHub or Cloudflare Pages project; Purchase our Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack; Set up a payment pipeline using NOWPayments and configure your delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2; Test your infrastructure end-to-end; Go live and start processing transactions; Monitor and scale your infrastructure as your business grows.
